title: Trunk-Caster button panel
description: A grid of buttons that acts as a keypanel on one port of one matrix. Used by Stream Deck (via Companion), by streamdeck_emulator.py, and by anything else that can press keys over the HTTP API.

device.description: The physical or emulated button device.

key_px.description: Key image size in pixels (72 for classic Stream Deck keys, 96 for XL/MK2, 120 for Plus).

encoders.description: Rotary encoders on the device (Stream Deck Plus has 4).

serial.description: Optional hardware serial so a profile sticks to one deck.

matrix.description: Alpha of the matrix this panel lives on, e.g. LOND.

port.description: Port number this panel occupies on that matrix. 0 = claim the next free keypanel port on connect.

api.description: Base URL of the matrix API, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. May be overridden on the command line.

name_on_matrix.description: How the panel introduces itself when it claims a port.

poll_ms.description: How often to poll /api/port for feedback (incoming calls).

pages.description: Optional extra pages of buttons, keyed by page name. The top-level buttons array is page 'main'.

label.description: Text on the key. Use \n for a second line. If omitted the target alpha is shown.

target.description: Port number or alpha on the same matrix (talk/listen), 'ICOM:port' for call (e.g. PARI:5), page name for page.

icon.description: Optional PNG path for the key face (72x72 / 96x96 / 120x120).

hold_to_latch_ms.description: Momentary keys become latched if held longer than this.
